req_desc: The product is a public marketing surface joined to a sign-up surface, plus a small console for whoever owns a site ...
A visitor reads every marketing route without signing in ...
`POST /api/auth/login` returns an access token for a correct email-password pair ...
Ten named routes answer, beside the nine aliases, beside the catch-all ...
The page ground reads near-white, the headlines near-black, the body copy mid neutral ...
Every scaled value is the canvas value times window width over canvas width ...
One Node process serves the rendered routes beside the HTTP interface ...
Eight tables carry the product, under timestamps in UTC ...
No page editor ships: no node tree, no session protocol, no undo ...
